notablePrerequisites:
Triad of Fates does not have summoning sickness.
Skullbriar has at least one fate counter on it.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {W}.
description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Actviate Triad of Fates' second ability by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can produce at least {1}{W}, this combo will net infinite mana.
